held.title: Names removed from mark_failed may still be imported or patched elsewhere.
held.body: This change removes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn` and the failure maps from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, and it renames the threshold function to `try_incident_threshold`. Any remaining `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import ...` will fail with an ImportError. The same goes for any `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.<name>")` in tests or other modules, such as the clock tasks and the issue-occurrence tests. I could not see the rest of the PR to check whether these callers were updated. Search the codebase for the old module path and either update the callers or re-export the old names.
